typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TYPE as string,
		BREAKTYPE as string,
		INVENTORY as string,
		QUANTITY as decimal(17,5),
		DTL_PL as string,
		MTD_PL as string,
		YTD_PL as string,
		MARKET_VALUE as decimal(17,2),
		CUSIP as string,
		TICKERSYMBOL as string,
		INSTRUMENTDESCRIPTION as string,
		PRODUCTTYPE1 as string,
		PRODUCTTYPE2 as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as decimal(38,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		EffDate as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EffDate_Drv = toDate(toString((substring(toString(toString(EFFECTIVEDATE)), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(toString(EFFECTIVEDATE)), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(toString(EFFECTIVEDATE)), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> GetLoadDate
GetLoadDate derive({Copy of BREAKTYPE} = BREAKTYPE,
		{Copy of QUANTITY} = QUANTITY,
		{Copy of EffDate_Drv} = EffDate_Drv,
		{Copy of DTL_PL} = DTL_PL,
		{Copy of MARKET_VALUE} = MARKET_VALUE,
		{Copy of PRODUCTTYPE1} = PRODUCTTYPE1,
		{Copy of MTD_PL} = MTD_PL,
		{Copy of loadDate} = loadDate,
		{Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE} = EFFECTIVEDATE,
		{Copy of CUSIP} = CUSIP,
		{Copy of TYPE} = TYPE,
		{Copy of PRODUCTTYPE2} = PRODUCTTYPE2,
		{Copy of INSTRUMENTDESCRIPTION} = INSTRUMENTDESCRIPTION,
		{Copy of TICKERSYMBOL} = TICKERSYMBOL,
		{Copy of INVENTORY} = INVENTORY,
		{Copy of YTD_PL} = YTD_PL) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of EffDate_Drv} == EffDate,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		InstrumentDescription as string,
		BreakType as string,
		Quantity as integer,
		EffDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ProductTypeClass as string,
		YTD_PL as integer,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Cusip as string,
		MarketValue as integer,
		Type as string,
		DTL_PL as integer,
		TickerSymbol as string,
		MTD_PL as integer,
		Inventory as string,
		ProductTypeSubClass as string,
		EffectiveDate as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		InstrumentDescription = {Copy of INSTRUMENTDESCRIPTION},
		BreakType = {Copy of BREAKTYPE},
		Quantity = {Copy of QUANTITY},
		EffDate = {Copy of EffDate_Drv},
		ProductTypeClass = {Copy of PRODUCTTYPE1},
		YTD_PL = {Copy of YTD_PL},
		loadDate = {Copy of loadDate},
		Cusip = {Copy of CUSIP},
		MarketValue = {Copy of MARKET_VALUE},
		Type = {Copy of TYPE},
		DTL_PL = {Copy of DTL_PL},
		TickerSymbol = {Copy of TICKERSYMBOL},
		MTD_PL = {Copy of MTD_PL},
		Inventory = {Copy of INVENTORY},
		ProductTypeSubClass = {Copy of PRODUCTTYPE2},
		EffectiveDate = {Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
